# A session outside any software project becomes a single-agent task (created here by the
# prototype's real hook), then turns into a software project with `init`.
> mkdir -p app && echo '{"session_id":"s-1","cwd":"'"$W"'/app","transcript_path":"","source":"startup"}' | CLAUDE_ENV_FILE="$W/env" python3 "$PYLACARTA" hook session-start > /dev/null
@env env
$ status
$ ask --title "Which fix?" --option "Patch|Small change" --option "Rewrite|Cleaner"
$ phase add --title x --goal y
$ agent start --role implementation --task x
$ models
$ models --json
$ inbox
$ status
$ answer Q-1 --choice Rewrite
$ wait
$ decisions
$ agent list
$ --project $LACARTA_PROJECT status
$ --root app status
